calibration.note: Yesterday's midday reduce gate at 77,480.0 fired at the 20:00Z close of 77,410.3 and price ran on to 77,254.5, so the trim was 605.7 points better within three hours. It has since been overtaken: spot at 78,700.9 is 840.7 points above the 77,860.2 reduce price, so measured now the trim cost money. That is the honest grade - right for the session, wrong for the swing. The transferable lesson is that a reduce triggered on a hawkish macro headline, with the daily structure still above all four EMAs, is a session trade and needs a re-entry plan attached, not an open-ended flat.
